d.seg: इंस्टाग्राम पर कनेक्ट हो गए मेरे साथ
d.ctx: The user asks to connect on Instagram after discussing locations. The expert responds hesitantly.
d.j: Proposing to move to a named external app (Instagram) is a strong case for PlatformMove.

d.seg: हाँ एक बार देख लो मेरी प्रोफाइल वहाँ सही लगे तो बात कर लेना वरना ब्लॉक कर देना
d.tr: Yes, check my profile there, if you like it then talk, otherwise block me.
d.ctx: The user continues the proposal to connect on Instagram by asking the expert to check their profile. The expert responds with surprise.
d.j: Proposing to check a profile on an external app is a strong case for PlatformMove.
